Vicat/HDT Softening temperature
Home » Analyses » Thermal analyses » Vicat/HDT Softening temperature 
With the HV3S HDT/Vicat tester, the heat deflection temperature can be measured by penetration of a needle (Vicat) or by bending (HDT). Three samples can be measured simultaneously. According to the ISO norm, the heating rate is 50 or 120 °C/hour, but can be altered if required. A binary set of weights is available for each measuring station to ensure that the correct weight can be applied. Zero deformation is automatically set at the start of the experiment.
